meta.title: Bookshelf · Your private reader for novels, comics and audiobooks
meta.description: Bookshelf – a lightweight local reader for novels, comics and audiobooks.
brand.name: Bookshelf
lang.label: Language
hero.title: Bookshelf
hero.slogan: One calm home for novels, comics and audiobooks — local‑first, privacy‑first.
hero.note: Free forever. Optional Pro unlocks unlimited shelf and advanced tools.
screen.alt1: Bookshelf library grid of book covers with titles, authors, and reading progress
screen.alt2: Night reading view with a selected passage and highlight controls
screen.alt3: Comics library grid of comic covers with titles and reading progress
features.title: Everything you need in one reader
features.sub: Novels, comics and audiobooks — handled gracefully.
features.f1.title: Supported formats
features.f1.body: TXT, EPUB and FB2 novels. CBZ, ZIP, CBR, RAR, PDF and loose-image comics. MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, AIFF, CAF and FLAC audiobooks.
features.f2.title: Easy import
features.f2.body: Use the file picker, or open the transfer screen to start a temporary server on the local Wi-Fi network. A one-time code protects uploads, and the device is discoverable by name (Bonjour).
features.f3.title: Two reading modes
features.f3.body: Page mode for linear readers, scroll mode for manga and long‑form content.
features.f4.title: Theme and typography
features.f4.body: Custom fonts, line height, margins, day/night mode, and a custom reading background image (Pro).
features.f5.title: Audiobook player
features.f5.body: Chaptered playback, playback speed, sleep timer, and auto‑resume.
features.f6.title: Comic‑friendly
features.f6.body: Scroll or paged reading, zoom, right‑to‑left support, and per‑comic settings override (Pro).
features.f7.title: Offline‑first
features.f7.body: Your books, progress and notes stay on this device. There is no account. We never upload your files. iOS device backups (iCloud/Finder) are managed by the system and may include app data.
features.f8.title: Pro unlock
features.f8.body: Unlimited shelf, hidden books, custom chapter rules, per-comic settings, alternate icons, a custom reading background image, view reading statistics (Pro), and batch operations. Reading time is recorded on this device for everyone.
pro.title: Free or Pro — pick your shelf
pro.sub: Start free, upgrade when you need more room.
pro.r1: 25 items in total (novels, comics and audiobooks combined). Existing items are never locked.
pro.note: Prices shown inside the App; one-time purchase, no subscription.
lang.title: Your language is welcome
lang.body: Bookshelf ships with 12 interface languages — and we keep adding more.
footer.tag: A calm home for every book you love.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro.body: Bookshelf is local-first and privacy-first. We do not collect, upload or sell your personal data. There is no account system and no analytics.
privacy.local.books: Book files and cover images are stored only in the App’s sandbox.
privacy.local.progress: Reading progress, bookmarks, highlights, notes and settings are kept on this device.
privacy.local.backup: You can export and restore a free local backup at any time. Automatic backup, when turned on, keeps only the last 2 copies on this device. Deleting the App removes all of that data.
privacy.faceid.body: Face ID is used only on-device to unlock hidden books and for the optional App Lock. Biometric data is handled by iOS; the App never receives or stores it.
privacy.wifi.body: While the transfer screen is open, Wi-Fi import runs a temporary server on the local Wi-Fi network. It is protected by a one-time code and is discoverable on the local network by this device’s name (Bonjour). Files go from the browser to this device and are not uploaded to us.
privacy.sdk.body: The App includes no advertising, analytics, crash-reporting or social-login SDKs. It reads books on your device to display and search them, and does not upload that text. It uses Apple frameworks such as StoreKit and Face ID. It does not use push or local notifications.
privacy.purchase.body: Pro is a one-time purchase processed entirely by Apple. We never see your payment details, and you can restore purchases at any time in Settings.
privacy.delete.body: To remove everything, delete the App from your device. Local books, progress and settings are removed with it.
privacy.contact.body: Questions about privacy? Email us and we will reply within 30 days.
hero.coming: Coming soon to the App Store
support.title: Support
support.lead: A few answers are below. You can also email us.
support.import.a: Use the file picker in the library. Novels can be TXT, EPUB, or FB2. Comics can be CBZ, ZIP, CBR, RAR, PDF, or loose images. Audiobooks can be MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, AIFF, CAF, or FLAC. Files stay on this device.
support.wifi.a: While the transfer screen is open, Bookshelf runs a temporary server on the local Wi-Fi network. A one-time code protects uploads, and the device is discoverable on the local network by its name (Bonjour). Files go from the browser to this device and are not uploaded to us.
support.restore.a: Pro is a one-time purchase handled by Apple. In Settings, tap Restore Purchase to bring a previous purchase onto this device.
support.delete.a: Delete the app from your device to remove everything. Local books, progress, and settings are removed with it. There is no account to close.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.notice: These terms are shown in Chinese and English. Both versions have equal effect. If they conflict, the English version controls.
terms.intro: Welcome to Bookshelf (the "App"). By downloading, installing or using the App you agree to these Terms.
terms.s1.title: 1. Description of service
terms.s1.body:
Bookshelf is a local-first reader that helps you read novels, comics and audiobooks on your iOS device. The App:
• Does not store your shelf content, reading progress or personal data on any server
• Requires no account sign-up
• Offers a Free tier and an optional paid Pro tier (one-time purchase)

We may update, change or discontinue parts of the App at any time, and will give reasonable notice where practicable.
terms.s2.title: 2. Your content
terms.s2.body:
• The App reads imported files on your device so it can display them, search them and detect chapters. Those files are not uploaded.
• You keep all rights to any content you import or create (notes, bookmarks).
• We do not analyze, train on or commercially use that content.
terms.s3.title: 3. Pro purchase
terms.s3.body:
• Pro is a one-time non-consumable purchase. It is not a subscription and does not auto-renew or charge repeatedly.
• Prices are clearly shown inside the App. Entitlement follows Apple's transaction record: it unlocks after a successful purchase, and it is removed if Apple refunds or revokes the transaction.
• You can restore a still-valid purchase from Settings → Restore Purchase.
• All payments and refunds are processed by Apple. Bookshelf does not process and cannot see any payment information.
terms.s4.title: 4. Acceptable use
terms.s4.body:
You agree not to:
• Use the App for any purpose that violates local laws
• Reverse-engineer, decompile, crack or circumvent the App's technical protections
• Distribute viruses, malware or content that infringes third-party intellectual property
terms.s5.title: 5. Third-party content
terms.s5.body: The App is only a reader; it does not host or moderate the books you import. You are responsible for ensuring you own or have the right to read the content you import. We are not liable for any third-party content.
terms.s6.title: 6. Disclaimers
terms.s6.body:
To the maximum extent permitted by law:
• The App is provided "as is" without any express or implied warranties
• We do not warrant that the App will meet your particular purpose, or that operation will be uninterrupted or error-free
• We are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages arising from your use of the App
terms.s7.title: 7. Limitation of liability
terms.s7.body: If we are found liable for loss caused by our negligence or gross negligence, our total liability will not exceed the amount you actually paid for Pro inside the App, if any.
terms.s8.title: 8. Termination
terms.s8.body: We may suspend or terminate your access to the App if you violate these Terms. Your local data inside the App remains yours after termination.
terms.s9.title: 9. Governing law and disputes
terms.s9.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction from which you downloaded the App. Any dispute will first be resolved amicably; if that fails, it will be submitted to the courts of competent jurisdiction.
terms.s10.title: 10. Changes to these Terms
terms.s10.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Updates will be posted inside the App or on our website. Your continued use of the App after posting means you accept the updated Terms.
terms.s11.title: 11. Contact
terms.s11.body: If you have any questions about these Terms, email dev@sx029.com.
privacy.local.readingTime: Reading time is recorded on this device only.
privacy.local.deviceBackup: We never upload your files. iOS device backups (iCloud/Finder) are managed by the system and may include app data.
features.f9.title: Read aloud
features.f9.body: Text-to-speech reads the book aloud and highlights the current paragraph, using system voices.
features.f10.title: Highlights, notes and bookmarks
features.f10.body: Highlight passages, write notes, and drop bookmarks as you read.
features.f11.title: Search and contents
features.f11.body: Search the whole book and jump from the table of contents.
features.f12.title: App Lock and hidden books
features.f12.body: Optional App Lock with Face ID. Hidden books stay out of the library until you unlock them.
features.f13.title: Free backup
features.f13.body: Export and restore a local backup for free. Automatic backup keeps the last 2 copies on this device.
features.f14.title: iPhone and iPad
features.f14.body: Built for iPhone and iPad on iOS 18.5 or later.
features.f15.title: Lock screen and mini player
features.f15.body: Control audiobooks from the lock screen, and keep the mini player while you browse the library.
features.f16.title: PDF pages
features.f16.body: A PDF is imported as comic pages and read as page images.
support.pdf.a: PDFs are imported as comic pages and read as page images, not as reflowable text.
